name: Creamy Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Cream butter, add sugar slowly, then wine and cream.
Beat well and just before using, place bowl over hot water and stir till creamy, but not enough to melt the butter.
When the wine and cream are added, the sauce has a curdled appearance. This is removed by beating and heating enough to blend materials.
Sauce should be cold when served.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream butter, add sugar slowly, then wine and cream.
2. Beat well and just before using, place bowl over hot water and stir till creamy, but not enough to melt the butter.
3. When the wine and cream are added, the sauce has a curdled appearance. This is removed by beating and heating enough to blend materials.
4. Sauce should be cold when served.
